CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content presentation or access is present.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates (red) are given alongside explicit origin/organizational metadata including an executed_branch_claim status for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content presentation/access; terms like 'candidate' or 'current' are operational but not an attention-allocation relation.

C.rationale: Multiple entries identify specific content items and attributes (e.g. red/blue coordinate sets) as explicit content descriptions.

D.rationale: The report separately records content (coordinates) and an origin/status flag (executed_branch_claim=false) for the same referent/time, distinguishing identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: Origins, inheritance and represented_time fields explicitly describe how contents are organized/presented (e.g. copied_prior_record, native_conditional_record, inherited_current).
